notes: One adapter per VPN app: how BxRig asks its status, connects, disconnects, lists locations and picks one. Adding a provider is one more object here (or in ~/.config/bxrig/vpn-providers.json, which adds or replaces providers by id); the code only knows the parser names. argv templates are arrays, never shell strings; {location} is one argument, {location*} is the location split on spaces (mullvad: country and city). verified: yes = every command was read in the vendor's own documentation, partial = some were (see note), no = none were.

providers.name: NordVPN
providers.note: status, connect, disconnect and countries are on support.nordvpn.com (checked 2026-11-17). Picking a country by name (connect COUNTRY, names as `nordvpn countries` prints them) is from `nordvpn help connect`, not from that page. Log in once with `nordvpn login`; `bxrig vpn nordvpn setup` starts the daemon.

providers.name: NordLayer
providers.note: help.nordlayer.com confirms `nordlayer connect GATEWAY-ID` and `nordlayer settings set` (checked 2026-11-17). status, gateways and disconnect, and the text they print, are NOT in the pages read: the parsers are tolerant and the output may need adjusting. Never run it with sudo; your user must be in the nordlayer group (log out and in after the install). Log in with the NordLayer app first.

providers.name: Tailscale
providers.note: tailscale up, down, set --exit-node=NAME (empty value clears it), exit-node list and status --json are on tailscale.com/kb/1080/cli (checked 2026-11-17). The JSON fields read (BackendState, Peer, ExitNode, ExitNodeOption, HostName) are the ones the Tailscale client's status struct has; the page only says the output is detailed JSON. Needs `sudo tailscale set --operator=$USER` once, or tailscaled run for your user.

providers.name: Mullvad
providers.note: status, connect, disconnect, relay list and relay set location COUNTRY [CITY] are on mullvad.net/en/help/how-use-mullvad-cli (checked 2026-11-17). The text of status and relay list is read by the parsers; its exact lines vary between app versions.

profiles.name: Network profiles
profiles.note: Saved NetworkManager connections of type vpn or wireguard (nmcli connection show, up, down: networkmanager.dev nmcli manual, checked 2026-11-17). Import a .ovpn or WireGuard file with `nmcli connection import type openvpn file X`.

left_out.proton-vpn: The Proton VPN command line was not verified against Proton's documentation: no adapter row until it is.
left_out.wireguard: wg-quick needs root for every up and down: use a NetworkManager WireGuard profile instead (Network profiles).
